Exercise 1. a) The airport could be closed because of the fog. · b) The government announced a new plan ( ⁧قد⁩ + perfect: completion). · c) It's been a really difficult year. · d) The police closed the road before the procession arrived. · e) The minister may not attend the meeting. · f) Maybe he's late because of the traffic. · g) Perhaps the reason is lack of funding. Exercise 2. a) 5 · It is certain that the elections will be held on the scheduled date. · b) 2 · Parliament is unlikely to approve the law. · c) 3 · The number of tourists may increase. · d) 1 · It is impossible for the project to end this year. · e) 4 · In all probability the interest rate will remain unchanged. · f) 3 · It is not excluded that the government resigns. · g) 5 · There is no doubt that the crisis has affected tourism. Exercise 3 · Example. 5: ⁧مِنَ المُؤَكَّدِ أَنَّ افْتِتَاحَ المَلْعَبِ سَيَتَأَخَّرُ⁩ . It is impossible that the opening of the tobogganing stadium. 4. a) Obligation: All passengers must fasten their seat belt. · b) opportunity: We should (we should) reconsider the plan. · c) Wait: The train should arrive at ten. · d) missed wait: The train should have arrived at ten (but did not arrive). · e) calendar: The summit is scheduled for spring. · f) deduction: You must have forgotten your appointment. · g) obligation: Companies are required to submit their reports before the end of March. Exercise 5. a) The campaign was successful to some extent. · b) Prices are relatively stable. · c) Young people mostly prefer to live in the city. · d) The works have already (actually) begun. · e) The decision was certainly right. · f) The sector will suffer one way or another. Exercise 7. a) a small possibility · b) a probable scenario · c) assumptions, estimates (most likely) · d) an inevitable thing · e) pessimistic forecasts · f) unconfirmed, uncertain Exercise 8. a) The Minister may resign. b) It is likely that prices will rise. c) The experts do not rule out a recession. d) It seems that the agreement has failed. e) The delegation has arrived. f) It was expected that the president would visit Rome (the visit did not take place, or not as planned).
Exercise 9.

a) Table: The summit is scheduled for autumn ( ⁧من المقرر⁩ , calendar); There are several indications that the date may not be respected ( ⁧توحي⁩ … ⁧قد لا يحترم⁩ , 3, author); the host country is not yet established (made); another country is likely to offer itself ( ⁧يرجح دبلوماسيون⁩ , 4); It seems that the border dispute is not resolved ( ⁧يبدو⁩ , impression, author); the parties are unlikely to sit at the same table without progress ( ⁧من غير المرجح⁩ , 2, author); a postponement is not excluded in spring ( ⁧لا يستبعد مراقبون⁩ , 3); All options are on the table (secretariat, no grade); the summit will inevitably be held this year ( ⁧أكد مصدر دبلوماسي⁩ … ⁧حتما⁩ , 5); the postponement would certainly have a price ( ⁧لا شك⁩ , 5, author); Perhaps this explains the commitment of some States ( ⁧لعل⁩ , explanatory hypothesis). Contradiction: the observers (recommendable) and the diplomatic source (sure peak this year). Missed wait: the country that was to host the summit has withdrawn. By the end of the month, Member States must decide ( ⁧ينبغي⁩ ), because logistical preparations take at least three months.
b) More than ten million tourists (records), based on hotel reservations, already at 70% for July and August.

Experts: optimistic predictions to a certain extent. Warm waves could ( ⁧من المحتمل⁩ , 3) influence European tourists, who could ( ⁧قد⁩ , 3) prefer milder destinations; the expensive tickets could ( ⁧قد⁩ , 3) reduce the number of stays. Hotel Association: probable ( ⁧يرجح⁩ , 4) that coastal cities benefit more; Not likely ( ⁧يستبعد⁩ , 2) a strong increase in inland cities. Fact: reservations at 70% ( ⁧بالفعل⁩ ). ⁧لا بد⁩ and ⁧ينبغي⁩ the Minister express obligation and opportunity (political priorities), not predictions.

Exercise 10. 1. The central bank is likely to leave the interest rate unchanged, although some analysts do not exclude a slight cut. 2. The trial should have started last month, but it was postponed twice at the request of the defence. 3. It seems that the government has taken its decision: it has already announced the date of the referendum. 4. It is unlikely that the city will be able to host the championship, unless the stadium works end before summer. 5. The minister had to be aware of the report, since, according to parliamentary sources, he had arrived in his office two weeks earlier. Delicate points: in 1 two different steps (probably / not excluded) in the same sentence; in 2 ⁧كان من المقرر⁩ = event not occurring; in 3 ⁧قد⁩ + perfect (compliment) and ⁧بالفعل⁩ ; in 4 ⁧من غير المرجح⁩ + ⁧ما لم⁩ ; in 5 ⁧لا بد أن⁩ Epistemic (to be deuterium), non-obligatory, and source. Exercise 11. Personal answer. The tutor controls: six expressions of different steps used with the right construction ( ⁧أَنْ⁩ + conjunctive / ⁧أَنَّ⁩ + nominal sentence); a missed waiting formula; an obligation or opportunity; two mitigations; no source.
Exercise 12.

a) Rain possible ( ⁧قد تهطل⁩ , step 3) on the coasts; decrease in temperatures likely to occur ( ⁧من المرجح⁩ , 4). ⁧قد⁩ with the The past does not mean "maybe" but confirms a fact. ⁧لقد⁩ strengthens a done fact; It is used in speeches (we did it!)
b) ⁧من المفترض⁩ is a wait (according to the plan), ⁧يجب⁩ An obligation. Why "must" indicate both the obligation (-)
and the waiting (should be). That the expected event did not take place. Why use ⁧ينبغي⁩ Softer than ⁧يجب⁩ .

c) On the calendar: Parliament's special sitting on Tuesday on the budget. Probably: approval with ample majority; Plenty of rains in the north (expected). Possible: increase in the price of bread; floods in some valleys (not excluded). Unprobably, according to the government: increase in bread before the end of the year.
